CodeMirror editor bundle
========================

vendor/codemirror.js is retained from ctsilva/autark-tutorial at
4d5a6e37962f0fb343bd5a7f7d8d504fc88b730d. Only an ESLint directive was added.
The upstream bundle uses these MIT-licensed packages (versions from its lockfile):

@codemirror/autocomplete 6.20.4
@codemirror/commands 6.11.1
@codemirror/lang-javascript 6.2.5
@codemirror/language 6.13.1
@codemirror/lint 6.9.7
@codemirror/state 6.7.6
@codemirror/streamparser 6.0.0
@codemirror/view 6.43.15
Copyright (C) 2018-2021 by Marijn Haverbeke <marijn@haverbeke.berlin> and others

@lezer/common 1.5.5
@lezer/highlight 1.2.5
@lezer/javascript 1.5.6
@lezer/lr 1.4.12
style-mod 4.1.4
Copyright (C) 2018 by Marijn Haverbeke <marijn@haverbeke.berlin> and others

crelt 1.0.7
Copyright (C) 2020 by Marijn Haverbeke <marijn@haverbeke.berlin>
